subset_rng: numpy.default_rng(4041917), sequential seed/layer/fc1-fc2 draws, one expert per cell, all 40 retained

designs.A: Exact reproduction of original row-greedy and column-cycle matcher, all 1280 tensors
designs.B: Binary maximum-cardinality admissible edge selection on fixed 40 tensors; coordinate capacity one in either role, exact column equality, exact per-pair row/sign/stratum/calipers/A_H>=2*A_L, target cap2621; exact linear energy bound; evaluate SMD/KS afterward
designs.C: Same nonstructural rules and dose/coverage, exact rows; only column equality replaced by TV<=0.05. All tensors: LP on original coordinate-disjoint greedy edges plus conservative integer flooring; evaluate all gates without repair. Fixed subset: binary solver on alternative admissible edges as in B with TV bound. No additional relaxation

column_tolerance_interpretation: proposed design tolerance, not demonstrated harmless structural imbalance

solver.graph_restriction: If complete eligible edges exceed300000 retain all original greedy pairs then lowest(feature_cost,H,L) remaining up to cap; restricted infeasibility does not certify complete graph infeasibility
solver.C_all_tensor_LP_memory: bounded by worker address space24GiB; <=65536 original greedy edges

attrition.edge_counts: exact directed admissible pair counts from order statistics/orthogonal range counting; not attainable dose
attrition.coordinate_counts: unique union of coordinates having any H or L partner at stage; roles can overlap until disjoint selection
attrition.certification: Binary solver upper bounds only apply to stated graph and encoded constraints; SMD/KS checked separately, timeouts unresolved; LP-floor candidates have no maximum certificate

overlap_populations: Descriptive within-stratum lower/upper quartiles of existing A on bottom half; ascending A then flat index, first/last ceil25%; not new matcher eligibility
replication_unit: five original source seeds; tensor/edge/coordinate counts descriptive
scope: No threshold/dose/score/architecture/checkpoint search; no intervention authorized; original stopped experiment remains unchanged
